definition.loop: one iteration = read the key, compare the read value with the frozen verifier, and if they differ call correct(key, read_value, verifier_value); the read value is the credential
definition.one_step: initial CUP, verifier RED: the loop must read CUP, correct to RED and read RED back
definition.read_credential: initial RED, verifier GREEN: the correction must present RED (the read value), not a hard-coded CUP
definition.no_op: when the read already equals the verifier, no correction is issued and the log stays empty
definition.stale_read: a read captured before another actor corrects the address is a stale credential; using it must be rejected whole and the newer value must stay
definition.wrong_verifier: the table holds CUP, the verifier says GREEN; the loop accepts the correction because the protocol checks only the old value -- reported as a declared boundary
definition.plain_write: a plain write of the old value is still rejected; correction is the only path
definition.convergence: two iterations: the first corrects, the second sees agreement and stops; exactly one log entry
definition.default_table: on the 18-key table, correct an alias to another value and back; content digest returns to the original, R15 stays 40/40, zeros stay 0/0
definition.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after

criteria.one_step: read CUP, action corrected, read RED, log length 1 with from=CUP and to=RED
criteria.read_credential: read RED, action corrected, read GREEN, log from=RED and to=GREEN
criteria.no_op: no correction, read CUP, log length 0, content digest unchanged
criteria.stale_read: action rejected_batch_correction_mismatch, read RED, log length 1, content digest unchanged
criteria.wrong_verifier: action corrected, read GREEN, log length 1, verifier_error_accepted true and final_matches_ground_truth false -- the boundary is declared, not hidden
criteria.plain_write: action rejected_batch_address_already_bound, read CUP, log length 0, content digest unchanged
criteria.convergence: two reads, one correction, log length 1, final RED
criteria.default_table: content digest after the round trip equals before; regression 40/40 with wrong 0; zeros 0/0; log length 2
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: segments are reported separately; the wrong-verifier segment is evidence of a boundary, not evidence that the loop understands correctness
